To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
HIV controllers have robust AD CC responses that recognize a broader range of HIV- 1 Env and that glycosylation of Env is important for recognition of the ADCC epitopes.
HIV controllers have robust and broadly reactive ADCC responses against four major HIV- 1 Env subtypes.
HIV controllers have robust ADDC responses that recognize a broader range of HIV- 1 Env and glycosylation of Env is important for recognition of the ADCC epitopes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a broadly neutralizing antibody (bNAbs) against the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).
the development of broadly neutralizing antibodies against HIV, which could be useful for the development of an HIV-1 vaccine.
the development of an effective HIV-1 vaccine that will be relevant globally, irrespective of HIV-1 subtype.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ADCC is a promising correlate of protection and a potential target for an efficacious vaccine against HIV.
ADCC responses are broader and more potent in HIV controllers than HIV progressors, and that ADCC responses recognize a range of HIV- 1 Envs, with a bias towards subtype B and E. This

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the breadth of ADCC is broader in HIV controllers and the glycan-dependent ADCC epitope is conserved among different HIV-1 sub-types.
the breadth of ADCC responses to HIV-1 Envs in HIV controllers is significantly greater than in HIV progressor, which may have implications for the design of globally relevant HIV vaccines.
HIV controllers have robust AD CC responses against HIV Env, with a broad range of Env recognition, including recognition of Env subtypes A, B and E.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the HIV controllers have robust ADCD responses against HIV-1 subtype E, which has not been studied previously.
the breadth of HIV Env-specific ADCC is broad, and this breadth is significantly higher in controllers than in progressors.
ADCC is an effective immune response against HIV-1 and it is possible to design a vaccine to elicit ADCC responses.
